column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the lighting and safety record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment. FK to Equipment.EQUIP_CODE.
TEXT. Lighting status. Possible values: Auto, Off, On.
REAL. Light intensity percentage. **NULL means no light intensity data recorded.**. Example: 21.0.
TEXT. External lighting status. **NULL means no external lighting status recorded.**. Possible values: Auto, Off, On.
TEXT. Emergency light status. Possible values: Off, On, Testing.
TEXT. Fire detection status. Possible values: Alert, Fault, Normal.
TEXT. Smoke detection status. Possible values: Alert, Fault, Normal.
TEXT. CO detection status. Possible values: Alert, Fault, Normal.
TEXT. Gas detection status. Possible values: Alert, Fault, Normal.
TEXT. Emergency stop status. **NULL means no emergency stop status recorded.**. Possible values: Activated, Ready, Reset.
TEXT. Alarm system status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Safety system status. Possible values: Active, Fault, Standby.
TEXT. Life support system status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Oxygen supply status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Medical equipment status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Waste management status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Water supply status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
